barrier_index_deltas.interpretation: barrier-index deltas are too close to claim performance separation; the CRO pairwise result decides

decision_rule.inconclusive: If controls fail, replicate scatter ties the decisive pair, the lab deviates materially, or the measured rank only matches a hostile null, the outcome is INCONCLUSIVE/FAIL-CLOSED, not success.
decision_rule.key_pairwise: the Enhanced-65 > Envelope-65 non-obvious call must hold in the measured data (the single most decisive, PVC-contrarian bet).
decision_rule.power_caveat: n=4 rank has low power; the decisive, adequately-powered test is the key pairwise bet above, not the full 4-item correlation -- stated honestly, not oversold.
decision_rule.primary: PASS only if the measured immersion rank has Kendall tau >= 0.5 with the LOCKED rank AND a strictly higher tau than BOTH hostile nulls (solids-only, PVC-only).
decision_rule.third_party_hold: this locked rank + rule is registered with a third party BEFORE any panels are cut; the team may not re-demote-to-survive.
decision_rule.tie_rule: two tracks are TIED if their |Z|@0.01Hz overlap within replicate scatter (6 panels/track/arm default if budget allows; 3 panels/track/arm minimum floor); ties are excluded from tau, not narrated as agreement.

falsification: The bench (B117 comparative screen + D5894 + D870 + 60-90 d immersion/ISO 16773 EIS, ONE protocol, all tracks side-by-side, 6 panels/track/arm default and >=3 minimum floor) measures the true rank. The engine demonstrates value ONLY if it satisfies the decision rule above -- beating BOTH obvious nulls, not a strawman slash sheet. If not, the claim is honestly disproven.
honesty: The zinc-phosphate track's barrier effect is genuinely UNCERTAIN (non-monotonic literature): that uncertainty is exactly why the Enhanced-65>Envelope-65 bet is falsifiable and not tautological. No cross-study pooling is performed (invalid).
key_falsifiable_bet: Enhanced-65 (PVC ~11, zinc phosphate) OUT-BARRIERS Envelope-65 (lower PVC, no inhibitor) -- the OPPOSITE of a 'lower-PVC-is-better' heuristic; if the bench shows the lower-PVC track wins, the engine is FALSIFIED.
